detail.interpretation: The CO2-only-vs-total-forcing RMSE ranking DEPENDS on which forcing reference-level convention is used: with each series' own native baseline (ERF columns relative to 1750, Myhre relative to 1959), total forcing modestly beats CO2-only (0.08793 < 0.09378); with all three series consistently re-referenced to zero in the first overlap year, CO2-only instead beats total forcing (0.09025 < 0.09425). Neither variant is a physically fully-corrected re-initialization (that would need an explicit forcing/observation offset or a physically motivated deep-ocean initial condition, per Astra's review) -- both are reported so the small RMSE differences here are not over-interpreted as a robust finding either way.
